mainEntity.name: Can AI lead generation guarantee qualified leads or sales?

acceptedAnswer.text: No tool can guarantee that AI-identified prospects will become customers. AI may improve consistency by finding relevant public signals, grouping accounts, and preparing personalized drafts, but results depend on your offer, market, data quality, outreach, follow-up, and timing. Context is especially important for a new business because an attractive profile may not have budget or urgency. Measure qualified conversations, replies, meetings, opportunities, and revenue—not just records added to a spreadsheet. Run My AI Biz presents prospecting as an educational workflow for testing and decision-making, not guaranteed income.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. AI can help identify and prioritize possible prospects, but it cannot guarantee interest, meetings, or sales. Track qualified replies and revenue rather than list size, and verify that each prospect has a genuine fit and relevant reason to hear from you.
